items.html: Now, all these are the discernment of the twenty-two letters of the Torah, and the seven letters are vessels for ZON, which are the seven kings. And the fifteen letters are vessels for AVI, as mentioned above, since the posteriors of AVI are greater than all of ZON. And the mnemonic is that the number of the letters that are vessels of AVI is fifteen, like the number of Yud-Hey, and it is known that AVI are the first two letters, Yud and Hey, of HaVaYaH. And the letters of ZON are Shin-Ayin-Tet-Nun-Zayin, Gimel-Tzadi [ShATNaZ GaTz]. And the remaining fifteen letters of the alphabet are in AVI: six of them, which are BaDaK Haya, mentioned in the holy Book of the Zohar, are the posteriors of AVI, and the rest of the letters are the face of AVI.
